nodes.label: Disposable MySQL Demo Runtime
nodes.rationale: The builder rejects every database name except saverpos_demo_*, and --fresh drops and recreates only that named demo database; it never imports or reads production data. MySQL is the supported disposable fixture because the project's historical ALTER ... MODIFY COLUMN migration fails on SQLite.

nodes.label: Transfer Lifecycle Contract
nodes.rationale: Pending and in-transit transfers reserve exact Devices as IN_TRANSFER / TRANSFER_PENDING with a durable assignment; completion is idempotent and needs no new device payload; cancellation returns only reserved Devices; a completed transfer is undone only by an append-only reversal that is refused after a sale or other lifecycle change, and tracked transfer rows cannot be deleted.

nodes.label: RC-037 Receiving Exception Evidence
nodes.rationale: Receiving evidence is recorded separately from custody: observed codes and a note produce MISSING, EXTRA or SUBSTITUTED exceptions; unknown codes are stored as a SHA-256 hash with a four-character hint; an open exception blocks completion; and manager resolution records the decision without moving stock or changing Device state.

nodes.label: Exact Partial Return Rule
nodes.rationale: The requested return quantity must equal the number of selected exact devices, and only that subset receives the inverse movement; inconsistent physical state raises an error and rolls back rather than inventing movement.

nodes.label: P0 PASSED LOCALLY
nodes.rationale: Closure rests on a fresh MySQL migration/seed, a browser journey covering receive, transfer, sale, exact-device return, reconciliation and Device detail timeline, 145 PHPUnit tests / 966 assertions, and the static check. Physical scanner, printer and labeler validation remain explicitly out of scope: browser entry was keyboard text into scanner-compatible fields.
